editorial:
Imagine losing your husband and then heading to stay with his weird family to heal, only to find out they are all obsessed with demons. That is exactly what happens to Alice in this wild ride. You get to watch her navigate a house full of in-laws who are not just cold and distant, but actually turning into monsters that eat fear. The vibe is a perfect mix of scary and gross, making you feel like you are trapped right there with her while everything goes wrong. It starts slow to build the tension, but once the chaos kicks in, it does not stop.

You will love how the acting makes the horror feel real, especially when the family members start changing. The twists are surprising and the action scenes are loud and messy in the best way possible. While some of the middle parts drag a bit, the ending makes up for it. If you have a nice setup at home, you should definitely stream this in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the gore in detail. If you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great move for a rewatch.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, you find out that Alice's husband did not die by accident. He tried to stop his family from using him as a vessel for a demon. Alice realizes her love for him gives her power over the monsters. She uses a ritual to pull his spirit back briefly to help her burn the house down. Everyone dies in the fire, and Alice walks away as the only survivor, finally free from the family curse.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves scary movies with lots of monsters and family drama.
